failure_contract.detail: Device challenge is invalid or expired
inactive device registrations cannot rotate keys
a deactivated device must be registered with a new key
Not a member of this organization

invariants: public key identifiers are RFC 7638 thumbprints
only canonical PKCS#1 RSA keys from 2048 through 8192 bits are accepted
key validity and rotation grace are assigned by the server
rotation uses an exact version compare-and-swap
key rotation is exclusive even when an additional request field is explicitly null
deletion is an idempotent audit-preserving deactivation
deactivated registrations cannot be reactivated or reuse key history
deployed environments require PostgreSQL, Redis, native device authentication, and organization authorization
